items.label: Iran/Hormuz conflict -- no ceasefire, active escalation continues, Brent still elevated
items.detail: Live web search (2026-09-09 to 09-11 sources): no ceasefire in effect -- Iran's foreign minister confirmed there is 'not anything like a ceasefire.' CENTCOM destroyed 5 Iranian tankers Sept 8-9; Iran retaliated with a 20-missile strike on Jordan's Al-Azraq air base (first direct strike on a third-country US-ally base); Houthis separately struck Saudi oil facilities, wounding 73. Brent spiked to $101.21/bbl (Sept 9 close) then $107.63/bbl (Sept 10 close, +5.9%); a live check today (Sept 11) found inconsistent quotes of $102.59-$106.74 across sources -- still elevated, range not resolved lower. Hormuz shipping transit is down to ~12 vessels/day from ~130/day pre-war. Goldman Sachs still projects Brent easing to $85/bbl by December, but not imminently.
items.recommendation: Unchanged: do not add further to equity risk while the conflict is unresolved. The DBC hedges staged this run (materials cluster, and the pending SPY5/SPYL-cluster DBC tranche in instruction 101) double as partial ballast against oil-driven inflation shocks from this conflict.

items.label: US-Canada trade war -- escalated further (tariffs to outright import bans)
items.detail: Live web search: Trump signed proclamations on 2026-09-08 banning (not just tariffing) Canadian dairy/whey, alcohol, motorcycles and mopeds, effective 2026-09-29, replacing the prior 50% tariffs on those goods with an outright import ban under Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930; a further tariff-schedule change (adding ATVs and animal hides) takes effect 2026-09-15. Canada's Sept 8 retaliatory tariffs (15-50% on 700+ US products) remain in effect, and Canada doubled steel/aluminum duties to 50% to match. No uranium- or gold-mining-specific tariff action was found. CCJ ($9,751.00, 2.02% of NAV) + KGC ($8,076.75, 1.67% of NAV) = $17,827.75 = 3.69% of NAV.
items.recommendation: No direct action needed at the current exposure level -- neither CCJ's uranium nor KGC's gold-mining lines are named in the new bans/tariffs. Continue monitoring for any extension of the ban list toward metals/mining inputs, which would warrant revisiting this exposure.

items.label: September 16 FOMC decision -- hike odds have risen sharply, today's CPI print unconfirmed
items.detail: August CPI was scheduled for release today (2026-09-11, 8:30am ET) -- live web search could NOT confirm the actual released figure; results still showed pre-release consensus (headline +0.4% m/m/+3.4% y/y) and BLS's own indexed page still showing July data at query time. This is a genuine data gap, not a 'no news' finding. Separately, September-16 rate-hike odds have risen materially: from the 49-66% range cited in recent runs to ~71-73% per CME FedWatch as of 2026-09-10, driven by a hotter-than-expected August PPI print (+5.4% y/y, released Sept 10).
items.recommendation: Verify the actual CPI print directly against BLS.gov (or IBKR's own economic calendar) before any FOMC-timing-sensitive trade -- do not rely on this report's unconfirmed figure. The TLT (103) and DBC (101, 119) hedges staged this run provide partial ballast regardless of the eventual outcome.
